Sunol Glen School Board — 2026
# A steady hand
for every Eagle.
Jennifer is running for the Sunol Glen Unified School District Board of Trustees — bringing careful stewardship, plain-spoken communication, and a commitment to keeping this small district strong.
Get Involved See the Priorities
WWW.SUNOLGLEN.COM JENNIFER@SUNOLGLEN.COM
Board of Trustees — Vote for One
Jennifer for Sunol Glen
Sunol Glen Unified School District
Fiscal stewardship
Open communication
Small-school values
## Why I'm running
01 — About
Sunol Glen works because it's small — every decision the board makes should protect that, not trade it away.
Sunol Glen is one of the few remaining single-school districts in the state, and that's exactly what makes it worth protecting. I'm running for the Board of Trustees because our small size only stays an advantage if the district is run with discipline: a board that reads the budget line by line, asks hard questions about facilities spending, and explains its decisions to families in plain language.
I'll bring the same care to this seat that I'd want any trustee to bring — showing up prepared, listening before voting, and being reachable between meetings, not just during them.
## Priorities
02 — Platform
I.
### Responsible Measure J oversight
Hold facilities spending to the timeline and budget voters approved, and push for regular, plain-English updates from the Citizens Bond Oversight Committee.
II.
### Transparent communication
Make board decisions and district finances easy for families to follow — clear agendas, timely ParentSquare updates, and real answers at meetings.
III.
### Protecting small-school quality
Keep class sizes small and support for every student — including special education, delivered through the Tri-Valley SELPA — a board priority, not an afterthought.
IV.
### A district families can rely on
Support staff retention, safe pick-up and drop-off, and steady enrollment so Sunol Glen stays strong for the next generation of Eagles.
## Get involved
03 — Contact
Whether you have a question about the board, want to volunteer, or just want to say hello — I'd like to hear from you. Sunol Glen is a small community, and this campaign should feel like one.
